'''Card text:''' Deploy on Death Star: Trench. During your move phase, you may attempt an Attack Run as follows: Enter the trench: Move up to 3 of your starfighters to the Trench (no Force). The Dark Side may immediately send up to 3 TIEs in pursuit (no Force). Form a squadron: Designate 1 starfighter as the lead (Proton Torpedoes* required); remaining starfighters, if any, are wingmen. Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons now fire at Rebel (Light Side) starfighters (wingmen first, then the lead after those are wiped out). Hit starfighters are immediately lost. It's away!: Draw two destiny. Run, pull up: All starfighters move to the Death Star system card (no Force). If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, the Death Star is "devastated." X = ability of the lead pilot, or 3 if Targeting Computer is deployed. Y = total location cards at the largest Rebel base (Yavin 4 or Hoth). Z = the highest ability among TIE pilots at that location. *During Attack Run, not affected by Overload. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese 壊滅 is devastated; the English is blown away. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Attack Run]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}
